Market today: Tech and AI names are seeing mixed signals. Strong surges in Nvidia and Palantir show continued momentum in chips and specific AI plays, but the broader software sector is facing "SaaSpocalypse" volatility.

Your holdings: SOXL (-44.89%) and SPAL (-44.45%) need immediate attention. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying assets, and your deep losses are amplified by margin. SMH is also down -8.44%.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the software sector's volatility, especially for CRWD. Also, monitor if the chip momentum from Nvidia extends to other names.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged, deeply underwater positions while selectively looking for high-conviction opportunities in strong sectors.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its -44.89% loss and leveraged decay; margin amplifies this risk significantly.
SPAL is also down -44.45% and leveraged; review its stop at 21.38 or consider reducing exposure.
Consider a new buy in ARM at its scanner entry 282.1-281.61, with a stop at 280.31, capitalizing on chip momentum.
